subject: using rgeneric with R update: NULL environment is defunct

messages.author: f1572a038d61492c
messages.subject: using rgeneric with R update: NULL environment is defunct
parts:
Hi all,

 I had to reinstall INLA on the linux cluster at my work and I keep getting this error in using Rgeneric 

Error in exists("my.cache", envir = envir, mode = "list") : 
  use of NULL environment is defunct

The code I had been using before is below, and it comes from the line

envir = environment(sys.call()[[1]])

but, I am unsure what to do to fix it.

Thank you,

Jessica Godwin

rw.new = function(cmd = c("graph", "Q", "mu", "initial", "log.norm.const", "log.prior", "quit"), theta = NULL){
  ## assume 'tau', 'order', 'n' and 'm' 'n' is the dim of RW and 'm' is the aggregated length,
  ## averaging over n/m variables, non-overlapping
  
  ## the environment of this function which holds the variables and we can store 'my.cache'
  ## there.
  envir = environment(sys.call()[[1]]) 
  
  if (!exists("my.cache", envir = envir, mode = "list")) {
    nn = n %/% m
    stopifnot (nn == as.integer(n/m))
    R = INLA:::inla.rw(n, order = order,  scale.model=TRUE, sparse=TRUE)
    A = matrix(0, nn, n)
    j = 1
    for(i in 1:nn) {
      A[i, j:(j+m-1)] = 1/m
      j = j + m
    }
    A = inla.as.sparse(A)
    D = Diagonal(nn, x=1)
    assign("my.cache", list(R=R, A=A, D=D, nn=nn), envir = envir)
  } 
  
  interpret.theta = function() {
    return(list(kappa = exp(theta[1L])))
  }
  
  graph = function() {
    return (Q())
  }
  
  Q = function() {
    QQ = rBind(cBind(p$kappa * my.cache$R + tau * t(my.cache$A) %*% my.cache$A,
                     -tau * t(my.cache$A)),
               cBind(-tau * my.cache$A, tau * my.cache$D))
    return(QQ)
  }
  
  mu = function() {
    return(numeric(0))
  }
  
  log.norm.const = function() {
    val = (n-order) * (-0.5 * log(2 * pi) + 0.5 * log(p$kappa)) +
      (my.cache$nn * (-0.5 * log(2 * pi) + 0.5 * log(tau)))
    return(val)
  }
  
  log.prior = function() {
    val = dgamma(p$kappa, shape = shape0, rate = rate0, log = TRUE) + theta[1]
    return(val)
  }
  
  initial = function() {
    return(4)
  }
  
  quit = function() {
    return(invisible())
  }
  
  ## as some calls to this function does not define 'theta',  its convenient to have to
  ## defined still (like in the graph-function)
  if (is.null(theta))
    theta = initial()
  
  p = interpret.theta()
  val = do.call(match.arg(cmd), args = list())
  return(val)
}

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] using rgeneric with R update: NULL environment is defunct
parts:
Seems like that code is no longer valid with the new version R. I'll
check. Otherwise, you can just create another environment, and store it
there. it is just somewhere to store the variables so you do not need
to compute them all the time. It will also work without.
